answers.2_restore_and_async: Correct. restore/1 maps nil to delete_env and value to put_env (helper:119-124). scrub_ambient! snapshots before deleting and registers on_exit from setup, so it restores after the test and LIFO-after anything registered later; it returns :ok. with_clean_env uses try/after so it restores on raise, proven by env_test:112-121. All env-mutating modules are async: false: letflow_check_test_test.exs:113, test_parallel_env_test.exs:13, instrumentation:23, shard:23, diag:31, orphan:48. The only async: true module is the guard test, which mutates nothing. ExUnit completes async modules before starting sync ones, so no async:true module can observe the gap. config/test.exs and test_helper.exs read TEST_POOL_SIZE, TEST_PARALLEL_GROUP, TEST_PARALLEL_TEMPLATE_READY_DIR and MIX_TEST_PARTITION only at boot, and no runtime System.get_env of TEST_* exists in lib/ or test/support (grep), so deleting them in-VM is observable only by child spawns. MIX_TEST_PARTITION is correctly not deleted from the VM.
answers.3_conversion_semantics: No assertion changed: letflow_check_test_test.exs diff touches only the new setup line and one comment. shard_test and instrumentation_test replaced an identical charlist/false mapper with port_env/1, which additionally unsets non-listed ambient knobs; explicit values still win because port_env merges caller env over the scrub map (helper:90-95). diag and orphan previously could not express nil; they now also unset ambient knobs they never set (EXTRA_ARGS, SHARD, TOTAL, OFFSET, PRINT_SLOWEST, MAX_CONNECTIONS...), the intended change. All explicit values (N, POOL_SIZE, timeouts, grace, template-builds cap, TMPDIR, LETFLOW_DB_PORT, STUB_ARGV_DIR, extra_env) pass through. Duplicate keys from the diag/orphan `++ extra_env` list resolve last-wins via Map.new. No explicit value silently dropped. Redundant explicit nil entries in shard_test remain, harmless.
answers.4_other_spawn_sites: Elixir: none missed that read TEST_PARALLEL_*. A scan of test/**/*.{ex,exs} for test_parallel.sh, letflow.check.test and Check.Test finds exactly the 5 converted files plus the guard and env tests. Tests that spawn mix (admission, client_ip, login_directory, login_discovery, mail, platform_tenant, secrets runtime_config; enablement_gate_runtime; check_boundaries; login_directory_tasks; migrate_tenant_admins) neither invoke test_parallel.sh nor check.test; the ambient vars their children can read are TEST_POOL_SIZE, TEST_PARALLEL_GROUP, MIX_TEST_PARTITION (config/test.exs:76,87,112), equal to the parent's own, and several already nil MIX_TEST_PARTITION (admission_runtime_config_test.exs:32-35, migrate_tenant_admins_test.exs:175). TEST_PARALLEL_SHARD and TEST_PARALLEL_N are read only by the script, so those children are unaffected. Shell harnesses test/scripts/test_parallel_{create_burst,pool_sizing,tmpdir_cleanup}_test.sh are not referenced by .github workflows, mix.exs or ExUnit; create_burst sets only N and POOL_SIZE and does not unset SHARD/TOTAL/OFFSET, so it would be vulnerable if ever wired into CI (finding 2).
answers.5_guard_soundness: Sound for its stated scope. Own source avoids self-trigger: script name, 'Check.Test.run(' and 'letflow.check.test' are built from fragments, the moduledoc is heredoc-stripped, and the helper token is built from fragments so the guard does not satisfy itself. env_test.exs is itself a spawn site (literal ending test_parallel.sh at env_test:20 plus System.cmd) and passes via its alias. A sanity test (guard:70-82) pins the five known sites so an empty scan fails. False positives: a file with a literal ending in the script name AND an unrelated System.cmd( would be flagged (remedy with an empty allow-list is a pointless helper reference); none currently, by static reading. False negatives, documented in the moduledoc: runtime-assembled paths, command strings not ending in the script name, other spawn primitives, spawn via helper outside test/, .sh harnesses, and referenced-not-applied. Undocumented but minor: heredoc stripping also hides spawns inside heredocs (conservative direction), and a trailing (non-whole-line) comment mentioning the helper still counts as a reference.

findings.text: Helper moduledoc (test/support/test_parallel_env.ex:20-22) says the completeness test greps for every TEST_PARALLEL_* name; the test (test_parallel_env_test.exs:75-77) actually matches every TEST_* read, which is what makes the TEST_POOL_SIZE family covered. Fix wording only.

Three shell harnesses under test/scripts/*.sh run the real script or extracted blocks and inherit ambient TEST_PARALLEL_SHARD/TOTAL/OFFSET/EXTRA_ARGS and TEST_* pool knobs. They are not wired into CI today, so no current breakage, and the guard documents shell harnesses as a blind spot. Recommend filing a docs/issues item (tag test-hermeticity) instead of expanding this PR.
LETFLOW_DB_HOST/USER/PASSWORD are deliberately not scrubbed (documented). Impact limited to psql-stub WARN text; no current assertion depends on them.

scrub_ambient!/0 and with_clean_env/1 duplicate the snapshot-and-delete lines (helper:105-106 vs 113-114). A private helper would remove it; not worth blocking. No OTP or supervision concern (no processes introduced). No type-safety gap warranting a docs/issues filing.
